name: Coordinate-Cube Dimension
definition: For a nonempty binary class $C$, $d_{\square}(C)$ is the largest dimension of a coordinate subcube contained in $C$.
parameters: A finite nonempty binary class on a displayed coordinate set.
normalization: A singleton contains a zero-dimensional cube.
comments: Always $d_{\square}(C)\leq\operatorname{VCdim}(C)$, with equality for ample classes.
